subject.title: [Feature]: Fallback approval mode + model attribution in messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a core opt-in approval gate before executing configured model fallbacks, and what should the config, timeout, denial, and channel-delivery contract be?
rationale: The remaining request adds operator-facing config and pauses fallback runtime behavior, which repository policy treats as product- and compatibility-sensitive rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Design Default-Off Core Gate
options.body: Define a per-agent or per-session fallback approval policy with timeout behavior and delivery semantics before implementing the runtime pause.

options.title: Keep Fallback Automatic
options.body: Treat current fallback notices plus `messages.responsePrefix` model attribution as the supported visibility/control model and close this direction as not planned.

options.title: Route Through Extension API First
options.body: Add or refine an approval/event extension point instead of adding a one-off core model config key.

recommendation.title: Design Default-Off Core Gate
recommendation.body: Define a per-agent or per-session fallback approval policy with timeout behavior and delivery semantics before implementing the runtime pause.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history routes the model-fallback docs, strict model fallback policy, and config-sensitive model schema work most strongly through steipete.
